Boundary rule: validate inputs; keep DB constraints,
transactions, auth and business rules in their own layers.
• Pydantic validates and serializes data; it does not replace database constraints or transactions.
• LangGraph accepts Pydantic state schemas; TypedDict/dataclass are often preferred for speed.
• LangChain create_agent state schemas are TypedDict-based; use Pydantic for response_format.
• Keep separate input/output DTOs. Never expose secrets by returning an input model unchanged.
• Use the framework's current integration API and verify provider support for structured output.
Pydantic v2 patterns • Check provider/framework versions • Validate at system boundaries
